yanzhou.name: Yanzhou
yanzhou.description: A frontier city with a permanent garrison and a rough, martial culture.

north_steppe.name: Northern Steppe
north_steppe.description: Rolling grasslands where mounted nomadic sects roam freely.

dunhuang.name: Dunhuang
dunhuang.description: An oasis city at the edge of the great desert. A meeting point of cultures.

western_mountains.name: Western Mountains
western_mountains.description: Rugged highland terrain. Isolated sects here guard ancient and heretical techniques.

guangzhou.name: Guangzhou
guangzhou.description: A prosperous port city. Trade and foreign influences make it a cosmopolitan hub.

pearl_river_delta.name: Pearl River Delta
pearl_river_delta.description: Fertile river delta. Southern sects here favour powerful, grounded martial styles.

hangzhou.name: Hangzhou
hangzhou.description: Famed for its beauty. Scholarly sects and elegant swordsmen call this home.

suzhou.name: Suzhou
suzhou.description: A city of canals and gardens. The Jiangnan Sword Arts are said to have originated here.

goryeo_capital.name: Gaegyeong
goryeo_capital.description: The Goryeo capital. A disciplined martial culture with strong clan loyalty.

goryeo_south.name: Southern Goryeo
goryeo_south.description: The southern reaches of Goryeo. Closer contact with the Jianghu has produced hybrid martial styles.
